name: ODU Big Blue Fall 2018

venue.name: Webb University Center, Old Dominion University

information:
All net proceeds will go to Engineers Without Borders, a group of engineers who benefit underserved communities.

A second round of 4x4 (top 16), a second round of one-handed (top 16), and a fourth round of 3x3 (top 8) are tentative, and will be held if there is extra time (in that order).
